description.zh:
结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
>若TraceID长度为30，可不填；若TraceID长度不是30，则必填。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

> If the ID of the trace is 30 characters in length, this parameter is optional. Otherwise, this parameter is required.

description.zh: 查询分页的每页项目数量，最大值为100。
description.en: The number of entries on each page. Maximum value: 100.

description.zh:
开始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒。
>若TraceID长度为30，可不填；若TraceID长度不是30，则必填。
description.en:
The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

> If the ID of the trace is 30 characters in length, this parameter is optional. Otherwise, this parameter is required.

description.zh: 调用链ID。可在ARMS控制台的**调用链路查询**页面或**接口快照**页面获取。
description.en: The trace ID. You can log on to the ARMS console and obtain the trace ID on the **Trace Query** page or **Interface Snapshot** tab.
